title: a first-level unit abroad is not a US state
line: a person whose every place lies outside the United States (born at Misawa, Aomori Prefecture, Japan: the geocoder's province, a first-level unit of Japan) gets no row of a record the United States made (no naturalization, passenger list or city directory, and not the Veterans Administration's gravesite locator at her cemetery row) once her birthplace is resolved; a man with places in the United States keeps the draft-card and Social Security rows and the American holders of the obituary and cemetery rows

steps.say: the geocoder's own answer for the birthplace of Reiko Diane Davidson, as the owner's cache holds it (fetched 5 Sept 2026): two candidates, the city and the quarter of it, the province Aomori Prefecture

expect.why: the chain is Misawa, its province, Japan: the province is a first-level unit, typed state
Aomori Prefecture is no state of the United States, so no United States record is looked for
the Veterans Administration's locator (E03) holds United States veterans only

steps.say: a man of the harness tree with places in Pennsylvania, born 1880 and dead 1961
